title: Watering above, cutting the roots below
odia:
ଉପରେ ଉପରେ ପାଣି ଛିଞ୍ଚୁଚି
ଭିତରେ ଭିତରେ ଶିଅ କାଟୁଛି।
literal_meaning: On the surface, they sprinkle water; underneath, they cut the roots.
meaning_odia: ବାହାରେ ଉପକାର କରୁଥିବା ପରି ଦେଖାଇ ଗୋପନରେ କ୍ଷତି କରିବାର ଚିତ୍ର। ପାଣି ଛିଞ୍ଚିବାର ଯତ୍ନ ଓ ଶିଅ କାଟିବାର ଧ୍ୱଂସ ଏକାସାଙ୍ଗେ ରହିଛି।
explanation: Watering suggests care, but cutting the roots destroys what that care appears to support. The paired actions make the deception visible: a helpful performance conceals damage to the foundation. This edition reads the verse as a warning about outward assistance joined to hidden sabotage.
usage_example: Someone publicly supports a colleague’s work while secretly removing the resources needed to complete it. Another colleague might recall this image. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The repeated ଉପରେ ଉପରେ and ଭିତରେ ଭିତରେ divide the scene into what is seen and what is concealed. ଶିଅ means root: the damage occurs at the part that sustains the plant, beneath the visible act of watering.

graphic.caption: An imagined cutaway places outward care beside hidden damage.

english_summary: A show of care hides damage to the very thing being supported.
